[h2]Metamorphosis Soundtrack[/h2]
Music plays an extremely important role in Metamorphosis. It complements the plot and creates an atmosphere of anxiety and helplessness, deepening the feeling of surrealism.
Metamorphosis is a unique artistic expression, inspired by Franz Kafka’s novels, and takes place in a bizarre and surrealist world inhabited by insects and a corrupt bureaucracy. 

The game gave the composers a perfect opportunity to write music inspired by the expressionist era of art and music in the early 20th century. Composers Arnold Schoenberg and Alban Berg, as well later composers such as Bernard Herrmann were inspirations. The composers incorporated techniques of the era such as Sprechgesang (half spoken half sung), 12 tone, aleatoric, as well as tonal and atonal harmonies to invoke a past age that worked perfectly for the world of Metamorphosis.

[h3]Greetings Fellow, Arthropals![/h3]
That’s right, if you’ve decided to take the plunge into the surreal world of Metamorphosis, we welcome you to the colony of Arthropals. One of us! One of us!

We’re really glad that you’ve chosen to give Metamorphosis a try. Have you been enjoying your time exploring nooks and crannies and solving mysteries with 4 extra legs along to help? We’d love to hear your feedback, so please leave Metamorphosis a review on whichever platform you play it on.

If you’re a Steam Arthropal, we’ve got a patch for you! The patch consists of a few small changes that will help to optimize your gaming experience. 

[h3]Here’s the full changelog:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue with the Lawyer's body clipping with his robe 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Lawyer not picking up the Skull if the wig is dirty
[*] Improved the volumetric lighting behind Leni
[*] Fixed the incorrect environmental shading behind Leni
[*] Added a Depth of Field toggle to the graphics settings (Due to the engine bug, the DOF effect won’t be available on RTX cards. All other cards will have DOF on by default what can cause a significant decrease in overall GPU performance – this is both for AMD cards and non-RTX Nvidia cards)
[*] Improved performance: unused sublevels in Tower are now kept in the memory
[*] Fixed a camera overview bug which triggered when a camera was used instantly after a level loaded up
[*] Going back from graphic defaults now only requires a single button press on the gamepad [/list]

Thank you for your descriptive reports. Please don’t stop providing us with your amazing feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1025410/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/CPUcUZc]Discord[/url].

As the release of Metamorphosis approaches (more news coming really soon), we’d like to take a deep dive into the game’s design. We’ll focus on the gameplay mechanics governing the curious game world, its surrealist lore, and we’ll share new concept art, setting the mood for the real thing.

Here we go!

[h2]The Game[/h2]
Metamorphosis is a first-person adventure game set in a surreal world where your newfound abilities are your last and only hope for redemption. It’s a unique adventure, an intriguing challenge, and a captivating story with a mystery to solve, all inspired by Kafka’s curious imagination.

The game will provide an engaging and meaningful experience for players of all ages. Do you like adventure games or environmental puzzles? Are you looking for a narrative-driven game with a challenge? Are you a casual gamer hungry for an interesting story? It’s all here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603900/bc4fd06cc5e8b6adfa21c135cfa70a83fa422d52.jpg[/img]
[i]Corridor picture - concept art[/i]

You play as Gregor, turned into a tiny bug, and set out on an extraordinary journey to unravel the mystery of your transformation. At the same time you must save your best friend Joseph, arrested for reasons unknown. Gather clues by observing your surroundings, reading letters, interacting with other bugs, and listening to dialogue.

[h2]Gameplay and Mechanics[/h2]

There are two main gameplay elements: solving environmental puzzles and platforming. Each area contains at least one unique puzzle you need to solve by observing your
surroundings, finding paths through obstacles, and interacting with objects.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mQBRMEb.gif[/img]
Exploration / Observation is a “how to get from point A to point B” type of puzzle, often through vertically designed levels. It’s best to explore and observe the area first, deciding which way to go and becoming familiar with obstacles, such as moving objects.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UhpIzut.gif[/img]
The Stealth / Avoiding Danger mechanic will have you plan a route to cross dangerous or exposed areas. The game visually indicates when you’re in danger.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eZPKYHt.gif[/img]
It’s no surprise that you can also jump and climb. Gregor can automatically climb or walk on any surface that’s not vertical (< 89°), and jumping is used for platforming and/or getting around obstacles, pathfinding, and reaching hard-to-get-to areas. Have fun doing parkour.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CiCUUJK.gif[/img]
And then there are Liquids—by walking through them, or storing and then using them, you can climb vertical walls or obstacles and walk over slippery surfaces. This Liquid sticks to objects and creates new paths for Gregor to traverse. When switching between >90° angled surfaces, the camera shifts, making the new surface the new “ground”. You can only carry a limited supply of Liquid, so plan your route well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UwAhJWd.gif[/img]
The Push / Interact mechanic allows you to push objects and interact with puzzles, use buttons or levers, etc. Use this power wisely.

[h2]The World[/h2]
There are three types of environments in Metamorphosis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603900/a490633c53ecf65d3ae6b27e1b9eea83f427d3ff.jpg[/img]
[b]The real world[/b], though familiar, gains new perspective with the miniaturization of the main character. Play areas include the inside of a gramophone, among the clutter of a desk, inside
cabinets and drawers, etc. Well-known objects tower above you, inviting you to explore nooks and crannies in different places of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34603900/129147fe0dec8ea3d13bc545ab0fc9453f5d6857.jpg[/img]
[b]The bug world[/b] lies hidden in the spaces behind walls, under the floor, or inside desks, where common sense and rules of the human world do not fully apply. As you make your way through passages leading to strange places, floating lands, and surrealist landscapes, you may meet other bugs, both friendly and dangerous.

The world of Metamorphosis is filled with [b]abstract spaces[/b]. Walk into a letter or explore a self-sorting cabinet—what other wonders will you discover?

That’s it for now. We hope we managed to pique your interest.
